errorCodes.meaning: Nothing at `url` answered as a Verifiable Trust Network. `details.message` carries the reason.
The network at `url` answers as a DID other than `network`, or its answer is not signed by the DID it answers as.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

version.description: The framework version the network operates under.

Response.description: The network, as the community found it at `url`, and where the community stands with it.

description.description: The network's description, from its profile.

entryState.description: The network's state for the community's entry, when it holds a published one: `listed` (not yet acknowledged), `acknowledged` (a member), `repudiated` (the community rejected the listing) or `suspended`.

listed.description: `true` only when the network holds an entry for the community whose listing verifies as the network's and lists the community as a community.

membershipState.description: The community's own record of the membership, when it holds one (`vtc/networks/show`).

name.description: The network's name, from its profile.

network.description: The DID the network at `url` answers as.

notListedReason.description: Why `listed` is `false`, in words for an administrator.

owner.description: The network's identified owner (VTI-VTN-002), from its profile.

roles.description: The roles the network asks members to register a group for. `vtc/networks/join` must assign a group to each one marked `required`.

url.description: The URL the network was read at.

Response.title: VTC Networks — Preview — response payload

description.description: What the network uses the role for.

name.description: The role's name, as `vtc/networks/join` assigns a group to it.

required.description: Whether the network admits a member only once a group is registered for this role.

schema.description: Read a network before joining it: what it says about itself, the roles it requires a group for, and whether it lists the community. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

network.description: The DID the administrator expects at `url`. When present, the community refuses if the network found there answers as another DID.

url.description: The network's API base, as the network's administrators gave it.
